arguments.command:
cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-host-2/workspace/task && cat scratch/transactions.csv && python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv, json
from collections import defaultdict
b=defaultdict(int)
with open('scratch/transactions.csv', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        a=r['account'].strip(); k=r['kind'].strip(); c=int(r['cents'])
        b[a]+= c if k=='income' else -c
out={k:b[k] for k in sorted(b)}
with open('scratch/balances.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(out)
EOF
cat scratch/balances.json; md5 scratch/transactions.csv
